children.text: SAIS - Abu Dhabi opened its doors in 2019, launching a purposeful and transformative educational mission. From day one, the school has been deeply committed to fostering academic excellence, innovation, and global citizenship in every student.

Our journey is inspired by the visionary leadership of Her Excellency Dr. Aysha Al Sayyar and Dr. Nawaf Fawaz, who established the first SAIS campus in Sharjah in 1997, followed by campuses in Dubai (2005) and Umm Al Quwain (2012). Their forward-thinking mission was and remains clear to nurture a generation that is academically strong, morally grounded, and future ready.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi reception lobby

children.text: We have cultivated a culture of achievement. In just a few short years, we earned a “Very Good” rating from ADEK, with “Outstanding” recognition in key areas such as student responsibility and innovation skills. In 2024, we proudly received ADEK’s Outstanding MAP Progress Award, a testament to the dedication and excellence of our students, educators, and leadership team.

Our success is driven by a collaborative community, committed senior and middle leaders, passionate teachers, and actively engaged parents. Together, we work to fulfill our school’s mission to empower every student to reach their full potential.

children.text: Our staff communicate with stakeholders through various channels to ensure students' wellbeing and academic success. Teachers create an inclusive environment by planning lessons that meet the needs of all learners, including students of determination and those who are gifted and talented. Student-led national and international events are regularly held at the school, helping students stay actively engaged with the wider community.

At SAIS - Abu Dhabi, we are committed to preparing our students to become lifelong learners who are curious, resilient, and driven to grow. We focus on developing strong character values such as integrity, respect, and responsibility. Through academic and personal development, we encourage our students to contribute positively to their community and make a meaningful difference in the world around them.

children.text: Dear valued students, dedicated staff, and supportive parents,

It is with great pride that I welcome you to SAIS - Abu Dhabi, a school where we nurture an enriching, inclusive environment, celebrating the uniqueness of every child and fostering a deep sense of belonging.
At SAIS, our philosophy goes beyond academics. We believe in building character and equipping students with practical life skills. Empowering future leaders who are ready to face challenges and excel in all areas of life is at the heart of our mission. This commitment to holistic development forms the foundation of our school’s vision.

We hold ourselves to the highest standards, expecting excellence from every member of our community. Guided by our mission and vision, we are committed to preparing students to become responsible, confident individuals. Throughout their educational journey, students are continuously encouraged to act as role models, demonstrating integrity, leadership, and respect in all aspects of school life.

Leadership grows through opportunity. We provide a safe, nurturing environment where students are taught to respect, value others, and engage as responsible citizens. We are proud to share that ADEK has rated us Outstanding in students’ social responsibility and innovation skills.

From Pre-KG to Grade 12, we offer a high-quality American curriculum enriched with innovation and real-world application. Our programs include STEM, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Project-Based Learning (PBL), and a strong high school programs. Students benefit from a wide range of electives such as Human Anatomy, Organic Chemistry, Design & Technology, Business Studies, Programming, and AP College Board courses. As a certified SAT, AP, and IELTS center, we ensure that students are prepared for various university pathways, the General, General+, and Advanced tracks.

We also take great pride in preserving and promoting our heritage subjects, enabling students to develop a deep appreciation of local culture, Arabic language, and values.
Our dedicated teachers are committed to nurturing each student’s growth academically, socially, and emotionally. We strive not only to help students meet high standards but to exceed their own expectations. Parents are key partners in this journey, and we deeply value their involvement and voice through committees like the Parent Advisory Council and National Identity Committee.

Beyond the classroom, we offer a rich After-School Activities (ASA) program and a variety of extracurricular opportunities, including MUN (Model United Nations), public speaking, arts conferences, and more. Our students actively contribute to the Abu Dhabi community by completing internal and external volunteer service hours, strengthening their leadership skills and engagement.
We believe in education that makes a tangible, positive difference in the lives of our students and equips them with the skills they need for lifelong sustainable success.
It would be an honor to welcome you to our SAIS community. Together, let us continue building a future rooted in excellence, compassion, and ambition.

Sincerely,
Principal Ban Al Duri

cards.description:
The Cognitive Abilities Test (CAT4) helps us understand how students learn and their academic potential. Students in Grades 3–9 take this assessment upon enrollment to identify their learning styles, enabling teachers to:

•	Adapt teaching approaches and materials
•	Adjust instructional pace and emphasis
•	Implement differentiated instruction

CAT4 measures four types of reasoning:

•	Verbal Reasoning - Understanding and reasoning through words
•	Quantitative Reasoning - Using numerical skills for problem-solving
•	Non-verbal Reasoning - Problem-solving using visual information
•	Spatial Ability - Thinking and drawing conclusions in three dimensions
cards.title: CAT4 Assessment

cards.description:
Students in Grades 3–9 participate in MAP testing three times throughout the academic year. These computer-adaptive assessments:

•	Produce accurate data about each student’s learning level
•	Identify areas of strength and opportunity
•	Measure overall performance in core subjects

•	Phonics knowledge

•	Deduction and inference skills
•	Understanding of figurative and idiomatic language

All tuition fees must be settled on or before the specified due dates as defined in the payment plan.
The registration fee is deducted from tuition fees upon enrollment.
An early payment discount is available for full payment made before the commencement of Term One.
For post-dated cheques (PDC), amounts will be considered paid only after successful clearance and credit to the school’s bank account.
A service charge of AED 500 will be applied for any cheques returned by the bank.

Please note:
Current dated or post-dated cheques will not be accepted for initial academic year payments unless submitted at least one month before the academic year commences.
Fees are considered paid only when credited to the school’s bank account.
A student’s registration is considered complete only after the first payment has been cleared, whether made in cash, by credit card, or wire transfer.
For wire transfers, all associated bank charges must be covered by the parent/guardian. Only the net amount received in the school’s account will be credited against outstanding fees.
The school reserves the following rights regarding non-payment of fees:
To send payment reminders via email, written notices, phone calls, SMS, and parent portal notifications to parents/guardians with outstanding payments.
To temporarily suspend students for up to three school days per term (consecutively or intermittently) after issuing three payment default notices.
To withhold the provision of learning resources, participation in extracurricular activities and field trips, and access to school ICT networks, library, laboratories, and other facilities.
To withhold transfer certificates, grade reports, mark sheets, transcripts, and recommendation letters for any student with outstanding fees.
To pursue appropriate legal action and/or inform relevant authorities to recover outstanding fees.
To claim legal fees and associated costs incurred in the recovery of outstanding fees.
In accordance with the Ministry of Education decree:
1. Parents/guardians must provide 30 days’ advance notice of student withdrawal and submit a formal refund request.
2. Withdrawal prior to the commencement of the academic year:
If initiated by the parent/guardian: The balance of the first term fee paid will be refunded; registration and admission fees remain non-refundable.
If initiated by the school: The amount corresponding to the first term fee paid is refunded, excluding the registration fee.
3. Withdrawal during the school term:
If a student attends any part of the first week or fails to attend without written notification one week before term commencement: The school retains the full registration or re-registration fee.
If a student attends two weeks or less in a term: The school will charge the equivalent of one full month of tuition fees.
If a student attends more than two weeks but less than one month: The school will charge the equivalent of two full months of tuition fees.
If a student attends more than one month in a term: The school will charge the full-term fee.
One month’s fee is calculated as one-tenth of the total annual school fees.

children.text: Our school library is a vibrant, multi-purpose space at the heart of student learning and creativity. It features a carefully curated collection of diverse books, selected to inspire a love of reading across all age groups and support academic growth in every subject area.

Equipped with a dedicated research computer center, the library also serves as a hub for inquiry-based learning and digital exploration. Beyond books and research, the space hosts a variety of engaging activities from reading events and storytelling sessions to workshops, meetings, and school assemblies.

Adding to its dynamic role, the library also houses the school’s radio station corner, where students develop their communication skills and broadcast school news and announcements. Whether for quiet study, collaborative projects, or creative events, our library is a welcoming and essential part of the school community.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi students reading together in the library

children.text: Our Makerspace is a dynamic innovation hub where students develop creativity, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills through hands-on, project-based learning (PBL). It provides an inspiring environment in which students can plan, sketch, prototype, program, and create while transforming their ideas into practical solutions.

Equipped with a wide range of advanced tools and technologies, including laser cutters, wood-cutting machines, 3D printers, LEGO® Education SPIKE™ Prime kits, WhaleBot robotics tools, and other STEAM resources, the Makerspace enables students to actively engage in Design and Technology, STEAM, robotics, engineering, programming, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) through meaningful and innovative learning experiences.

Through experimentation, design challenges, coding activities, and collaborative projects, students strengthen their creativity, technical knowledge, and innovation skills while preparing for the opportunities and challenges of a rapidly evolving world.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi students working in the Makerspace

children.text: Our school’s gym facilities provide students with a safe, well-equipped, and inclusive environment that promotes physical fitness, teamwork, and overall wellbeing. The school has two dedicated gym areas, one for boys and one for girls, ensuring that all students can participate in physical education and sports activities comfortably and confidently. Both gyms are equipped to support a range of activities, including football, volleyball, basketball, and padel, offering students opportunities to develop their physical skills, coordination, teamwork, and sportsmanship. These spaces are designed to encourage active lifestyles while ensuring that students learn, train, and play in a secure and well-supervised setting.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi students training on the football pitch

children.text: Our swimming pool offers a safe and well-maintained environment where students develop essential swimming skills, water safety awareness, and overall fitness. Lessons are delivered by qualified and trained swimming instructors, ensuring high-quality coaching and close supervision at all times. Through structured activities, students build confidence in the water while improving technique, coordination, and overall wellbeing. The pool supports an active and healthy lifestyle within a secure and carefully monitored setting.
